title: Mi Bombo
description: Mi Bombo adds modular multiblock missiles and aerial bombs to Minecraft. Assemble them and create powerful explosive weapons. The mod is compatible with Create, Create: Aeronautics, and Sable.
body:
# Mi Bombo

Mi Bombo is a warfare-focused expansion for Minecraft that adds modular multiblock missiles, aerial bombs, radiation mechanics, and nuclear weapons.

## Modular Weapons System

At the core of the mod is a modular projectile system. Every missile or bomb is assembled from several components:

* **Missile Tail** — provides propulsion and turns the assembly into a self-propelled missile that flies forward.
* **Missile Core** — the central component that connects all parts of the weapon.
* **Warhead** — determines the payload and effect of the missile, ranging from conventional explosives to devastating nuclear devices.

![Create Aeronautics compatibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a10c57d3e7f1d2b2359bbd32b431d2ca3efc40ce.gif)

## Warheads

The mod adds eight different warhead types with unique effects and destructive power levels:

* Conventional high-explosive warheads
* Incendiary warheads capable of setting large areas on fire
* Specialized payloads with unique battlefield effects
* Nuclear warheads capable of devastating large regions

The most powerful nuclear weapons can destroy significant portions of the landscape and leave behind dangerous radioactive contamination that persists for an entire in-game day.

## Radiation System

Mi Bombo introduces a radiation mechanic that affects players directly.

Radiation is measured in **kptk** and accumulates through exposure to radioactive materials and contaminated areas. As radiation levels increase, players begin to suffer increasingly severe negative effects.

For every 100 kptk accumulated, additional debuffs are applied, making radiation management a critical part of survival.

A **Dosimeter** can be used to monitor current radiation levels and assess environmental hazards.

## Uranium and Nuclear Technology

The End now contains naturally generated **Uranium Ore**.

Uranium can be processed into materials required for advanced weaponry, including nuclear missiles. It can also be crafted into **Uranium Rods**, which have several uses:

* Fuel for furnaces
* Consumable radioactive material that increases player radiation levels

## Radiation-Powered Equipment

Not all radiation is harmful. Some items are designed to consume the player's accumulated radiation as a power source.

### Rapid Fissile Accelerator

A specialized rifle that converts the user's radiation into destructive projectiles. The more radiation stored within the player, the longer the weapon can be used.

### Joker Mask

A mysterious artifact that consumes radiation to damage hostile creatures simply by looking at them. Radiation is transformed into deadly energy, allowing the wearer to eliminate enemies without conventional weapons.

## Compatibility

Mi Bombo is designed to work alongside:

* Create
* Create: Aeronautics
* Sable

Build missiles, deploy devastating aerial bombs, harness radioactive technology, and transform your world into an industrial military complex.
